rewrites.comment: Pass Expo's static asset bundle through unchanged. Without this explicit passthrough an over-broad catch-all below would return HTML for every .js file, producing a MIME-type error and a blank white page.
Same for the /assets directory (fonts, images bundled by Metro).

SPA fallback: expo export --platform web produces one index.html; expo-router handles all client-side routing in JS. Any path that isn't a real file (e.g. /listing/:id on a hard-refresh or direct shared link) must be rewritten to index.html so the JS router can take over. Without this, every shared listing link returns 404.
